scope: Read-only installed-source inspection on host A; no engines, GPU probes or runtime qualification. Conditional support requires correct checkpoint serialization, quantization metadata, BF16 model dtype and compatible backend.

untied_head.checkpoint_names: lm_head.* and model.lm_head.* normalize to registered head parameters

modelopt_nvfp4_head.support: conditional yes, including mixed NVFP4 experts and per-tensor FP8 body
modelopt_nvfp4_head.requirements: Serialized packed head plus block/global weight scales; valid activation scale for W4A4; no matching head exclusion; mixed recipe must select NVFP4 for lm_head

modelopt_per_channel_fp8_head.reason: Plain FP8 is per-tensor; FP8_PER_CHANNEL_PER_TOKEN is not dispatched and falls through to UnquantizedLinearMethod

compressed_tensors_per_channel_fp8_head.support: conditional yes under the compressed-tensors schema, not automatic composition with a ModelOpt body
compressed_tensors_per_channel_fp8_head.requirements: Explicit exact/regex head target and no head ignore match; E4M3 weight and channel scales [vocab,1], allocated FP32; compatible body schema and activation metadata

lmcache_environment_source_comparison.method: Read-only SHA-256 comparison; all eight inspected files byte-identical

modelopt_nvfp4_head.support: conditional yes, including mixed NVFP4 experts and per-tensor FP8 body
modelopt_nvfp4_head.requirements: No matching head exclusion; mixed quantized_layers entry for lm_head; correct packed/block/global scales and activation scale for W4A4

modelopt_per_channel_fp8_head.support: conditional yes using FP8_PER_CHANNEL_PER_TOKEN, including a mixed NVFP4/FP8 body
modelopt_per_channel_fp8_head.requirements: E4M3 head [vocab,hidden], FP32 scales [vocab], explicit mixed recipe and compatible dynamic per-token FP8 activation backend
modelopt_per_channel_fp8_head.simulation_layout_note: Our BF16-rounded [vocab,1] scale values must be squeezed and cast to FP32 for this ModelOpt serialization; plain FP8 is per-tensor and is not interchangeable

compressed_tensors_per_channel_fp8_head.support: conditional yes with explicit named head targeting and compatible compressed-tensors body/schema

accuracy_limit: The ablations use BF16 activations and reconstructed weights. Engine FP8 per-token activations, NVFP4 activation scaling and native kernel numerics are not modelled by their agreement numbers. No deployable mixed checkpoint was exported or engine-tested.
